title: "annual change glm mods"
author: "Rachel Lane"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), format = '%B %d, %Y')`"
params:
  parent_dir: "a12_cps_data" # relative to project root
  version: "2026-10-13"
output: word_document
---


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
```

```{r}
# function for easier navigation of relative refs
nested_here <- function(
    ...,    
    parent_dir = params$parent_dir, 
    version    = params$version
) {
  here::here(parent_dir, version, ...)
}
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
count_df <- read_rds(nested_here("data/cps_schools_analytic.rds")) |> 
          arrange(data_schoolyear) |> 
          mutate(year_seq = as.numeric(fct_inorder(data_schoolyear)))

write_rds(count_df, nested_here("output", "models", "glm_count_df.rds"))

count_mods <- c(
  "asthma_count",
  "food_allergy_count",
  "non_food_allergy_count",
  "student_504_count",
  "iep_count",
  "esl_count",
  "frm_count",
  "homelessness_count"
  ) |>
  set_names() |> 
  map(~{
    eval(bquote(
    
      glmer(
        arsenal::formulize(.x, "data_schoolyear + (1 | school_id)"),
        offset = log(student_count),
        family = poisson(link = "log"),
        data   = count_df
        )
    ))
  })

write_rds(count_mods, nested_here("output", "models", "glm_count_mods.rds"))

asthma_attd_df <- read_csv(nested_here("data", "cps_student_crosstabs.csv")) |> 
  left_join(read_csv(nested_here("data", "cps_name_id_crosswalk.csv"))) |> 
  mutate(
    days_observed = round(days_per_row_present),
    days_expected = round(days_per_row_expected)
  ) |> 
  
  summarise(
    across(
      c(student_count, days_observed, days_expected), 
      ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
    .by = c("school_id", "data_schoolyear", "asthma_status")
    ) |> 
  filter(days_expected > 0) |> 
  arrange(data_schoolyear) |> 
  mutate(year_seq = as.numeric(fct_inorder(data_schoolyear)))

write_rds(asthma_attd_df, nested_here("output", "models", "glm_asthma_attd_df.rds"))

attd_mod <- glmer(
  days_observed ~ data_schoolyear + (year_seq | school_id),
  data   = asthma_attd_df,
  family = poisson(link = "log"),
  offset = log(days_expected)
)

write_rds(attd_mod, nested_here("output", "models", "glm_attd_mod.rds"))

asthma_attd_mod <- glmer(
  days_observed ~ data_schoolyear*asthma_status + (year_seq | school_id),
  data   = asthma_attd_df,
  family = poisson(link = "log"),
  offset = log(days_expected)
)

write_rds(asthma_attd_mod, nested_here("output", "models", "glm_asthma_attd_mod.rds"))

```


```{r}
count_df        <- read_rds(nested_here("output", "models", "glm_count_df.rds"))
count_mods      <- read_rds(nested_here("output", "models", "glm_count_mods.rds"))
asthma_attd_df  <- read_rds(nested_here("output", "models", "glm_asthma_attd_df.rds"))
attd_mod        <- read_rds(nested_here("output", "models", "glm_attd_mod.rds"))
asthma_attd_mod <- read_rds(nested_here("output", "models", "glm_asthma_attd_mod.rds"))
```

```{r}
map(count_mods, ~{
  
emmeans(
  .x,
  revpairwise ~ data_schoolyear,
  offset  = log(1000),
  type    = "response",
  weights = "cells"
  )
})
```


```{r}
emmeans(
  attd_mod, 
  revpairwise ~ data_schoolyear,
  offset = log(176),
  type = "response",
  weights = "cells"
  )
```

```{r}
emmeans(
  asthma_attd_mod, 
  revpairwise ~ asthma_status | data_schoolyear,
  offset = log(176),
  type = "response",
  weights = "cells"
  )
```

```{r}
emmeans(
  asthma_attd_mod, 
  revpairwise ~ data_schoolyear | asthma_status,
  offset = log(176),
  type = "response",
  weights = "cells"
  )
```

```{r}
emmeans(
  asthma_attd_mod, 
  ~ data_schoolyear | asthma_status,
  offset = log(176),
  type = "response",
  weights = "cells"
  ) |>
  contrast("revpairwise") |> 
  rbind() |>
  update(by = "contrast") |> 
  contrast("revpairwise") |> 
  rbind()
```
